01-miners-after-halving.point: Hashprice fell to $38 per petahash per day
Median all-in cost to mine one bitcoin is $71,400
Only firms with power under 4.5 cents/kWh were clearly profitable
About 12% of hashrate expected to go offline or relocate within 18 months

02-cantillon-housing.point: Regional banks expanded lending by $2.3 billion
Prices near busy lending branches rose 18% vs 7% in outer towns
First-time buyer share fell from 34% to 22%
Recommendation: banks publish lending by zip code quarterly

03-quote-followup-agent.point: Time to first follow-up fell from 26 hours to 3 hours
Quote win rate rose from 31% to 37%
Wrong pricing went out on 14 quotes in the first month
Fix: human approval required for any follow-up mentioning price

04-lightning-coffee.point: Lightning costs about 0.4% vs about 2.9% for cards
Refunds are the biggest pain point
Expanding Lightning to 11 more new stores

05-law-firm-local-models.point: Models run locally on two Mac Studios; no client data goes to cloud AI
17 fabricated citations caught in the first 90 days
Every brief now requires citation verification

06-savings-time-preference.point: Member savings rate fell from 11.2% to 6.4%
Framed as time preference: near-zero rates removed the reward for waiting
Members under 30 hold median savings of $1,900
Advice: automatic transfer to savings on payday

07-ai-sdr-research.point: Research agent ran across 600 target accounts
13% of suggested first lines referenced the wrong news at first
Fix: cite sources and have reps review first lines before sending

08-self-custody-survey.point: 41% keep all their bitcoin on an exchange
16% of self-custody users have lost access to a wallet
Most common failure: storing the seed phrase digitally

09-data-centers-grid.point: Data centers requested 3.2 GW of connections
First large data center connection scheduled for 2029
Bitcoin miners curtailed for 212 hours last summer

10-grocery-inflation-index.point: Basket price rose 23% over three years
Advice: compare unit prices, not sticker prices
